substantive_checks.continuant_transfer: PASS: the beta recurrence gives q_(n+h)=P_h(n)q_(n+1)+P_(h-1)(n+1)q_n and the exact transition-minor identity
substantive_checks.casoratian_residual: PASS: C_h(n) is congruent to -P_h(n)q_(n+1)^2 modulo q_n
substantive_checks.level_equivalence: PASS: adjacent coprimality makes p^s divide C_h, P_h, and q_(n+h) equivalent whenever p^s divides q_n
substantive_checks.shallow_valuation: PASS: if v_p(P_h)<v_p(q_n), the two residual terms have distinct valuations and v_p(C_h)=v_p(P_h)
substantive_checks.height_bounds: PASS: positivity and the continuant recursion give (4n+6)^(h-1)<=P_h(n)<=[4(n+h)]^(h-1), hence O(n) residual height exactly for h=O(n/log n)
substantive_checks.universal_antiperiod_gap: PASS: the odd anti-period reaches every odd divisor M of q_n at h=M, but a high level M>N pays at least N log(4N+6)
substantive_checks.reservoir_deoverlap: PASS: replacing q_n by qbar=q_n/gcd(q_n,D_m) preserves the three-way divisibility equivalence prime by prime
substantive_checks.capacity_booking: PASS: the primitive single-minor class yields no little-oh squarefull theorem or beta-ceiling reduction and books zero

strict_scope.proved: One primitive growing two-state minor transports a level to a second sequence zero; the universal seed-only gap reaching a high level has main-scale residual height.
strict_scope.not_proved: No claim covers products or sums of a growing number of minors, arbitrary growing block determinants, or global short-return theorems.
strict_scope.finite_only: The portable bounded replay supplies identity checks only and contains no asymptotic singleton census.
